newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus accepts wheat, maize tenders.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus accepts wheat, maize tenders.

text.p: The Cyprus Grain Commission on Tuesday accepted a tender from Toepfer Athens for a combined shipment of 10,000 tonnes of spring wheat at $192.86 per tonne, and 8,000 tonnes of durum wheat at $227.66 per tonne.
It also accepted a separate tender from Recocer Paris for the supply of 18,000 tonnes of maize at $143.95 a tonne.
The prices include C&F, a statement from the grain commission said.

The shipment for the wheat is scheduled at the end of April or the beginning of May, while the maize shipment is scheduled for the beginning of May, according to the terms of the initial invitation to tender issued last week.
